text:
### What DECREASES Your Interest Earned  
❌ **Decrease Balance:** Drop below £10,000 threshold
❌ **BoE Rate Cut:** Automatic rate cut (margin fixed, so decline together)
❌ **Market Competition:** If competitors raise rates, FirstUK may follow suit (but typically match)

raw_entities.description: Customer-facing guidance explaining the conditions and circumstances that result in a decrease to interest earned on their account. Covers balance threshold breaches, Bank of England rate cuts, and market competition impacts on rates.
context: What DECREASES Your Interest Earned
Drop below £10,000 threshold

raw_entities.name: Balance Threshold for Interest Eligibility
raw_entities.description: Guidance on the £10,000 balance threshold that determines eligibility for the stated interest rate tier. Falling below this threshold results in a decrease to interest earned.
context: Drop below £10,000 threshold
Decrease Balance: Drop below £10,000 threshold

raw_entities.name: Bank of England Rate Cut Impact
raw_entities.description: Customer guidance explaining that when the Bank of England cuts its base rate, the account rate automatically decreases in line with the fixed margin structure, resulting in lower interest earned.
context: BoE Rate Cut: Automatic rate cut (margin fixed, so decline together)
Automatic rate cut (margin fixed, so decline together)

raw_entities.name: Market Competition Rate Adjustment
raw_entities.description: Guidance informing customers that FirstUK may adjust rates in response to competitor rate changes in the market, though the bank typically matches rather than undercuts competitor offerings.
context: Market Competition: If competitors raise rates, FirstUK may follow suit (but typically match)
